description: FREE — verify any attestation issued by the notary. Supply the attestation_id plus either the original content ({prompt, response, model_id}) or its content_hash. Returns the Ed25519 signature check, hash comparison, and a Merkle inclusion proof once the batch is sealed. No wallet needed.

client_timestamp.description: Optional ISO-8601 time the inference ran. Included in the content hash if provided.

content_hash.description: Alternative to supplying full content: the sha256 content hash to compare directly

prompt.description: The exact prompt/input that was sent to the model

response.description: The exact model output you want a receipt for

name: verify_attestation
